capabilities: Detect MM:SS and HH:MM:SS timecodes in note text
Convert detected timecodes into clickable links in reading mode
Recognize YouTube links in raw text, markdown link, and iframe embed forms
extras: README is minimal; it only states the conversion behavior and the supported YouTube link forms, with no usage examples or screenshots.
problem: Raw timecodes in notes are plain text, so there is no way to click them to jump to that point in a linked video.
summary: Plugin that converts raw MM:SS/HH:MM:SS timecodes into clickable links in reading mode when a note contains a video link.
